statements.status_notes: h2 0.3.27 is not compiled into the image. It is listed only because the cargo-auditable dependency data embedded in efs-proxy (amazon-efs-utils) records the legacy hyper 0.14 client of aws-smithy-http-client, which only the efs-proxy test dependencies enable (aws-smithy-mocks and the aws-sdk-s3 test-util feature). The efs-proxy build compiles hyper 1.x and h2 0.4.19 only.

GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h (RUSTSEC-2026-0258) is unbounded queuing of empty HTTP/2 DATA frames in the h2 crate. The only upstream patch is h2 0.4.16; 0.3.27 is the last 0.3 release and has no 0.3-line fix. Qdrant already pins h2 0.4.16 on the 0.4 line. The remaining 0.3.27 copy is a transitive dependency of the older hyper/tonic stack; moving it to 0.4 would be a major-version upgrade of that stack and is not adopted yet. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0258.html

h2 0.3.27 is pulled only by console-subscriber via tonic 0.9.x. console-subscriber is an optional dependency behind the tokio_console feature, which is not enabled in the release cargo build (cargo build --release without --features tokio_console). The vulnerable h2 0.3.x code is therefore not compiled into the shipped influxdb3 binary.
